steps.run:
if [ -n "${CIP_CHANGED_FILES+x}" ] && ! printf '%s' "$CIP_CHANGED_FILES" | tr ':' '\n' | grep -Eq '^(cmd|internal)/.*\.go$|^go\.(mod|sum)$'; then echo 'impact: no Go source/module change; skip'; exit 0; fi
if find cmd internal -name '*.go' -type f -exec gofmt -l {} + | grep -q .; then echo 'gofmt required'; find cmd internal -name '*.go' -type f -exec gofmt -l {} +; exit 1; fi
go vet ./...
go test ./...

if [ -n "${CIP_CHANGED_FILES+x}" ] && ! printf '%s' "$CIP_CHANGED_FILES" | tr ':' '\n' | grep -Eq '^(cmd|internal)/.*\.go$|^go\.(mod|sum)$'; then echo 'impact: no Go source/module change; skip lint'; exit 0; fi
golangci-lint run ./...

mkdir -p "$CIP_ARTIFACTS"
export CGO_ENABLED=0 GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false
build() { GOOS=$1 GOARCH=$2 go build -trimpath -ldflags '-s -w' -o "$CIP_ARTIFACTS/$3-$1-$2" "./cmd/$3" || exit 1; }
for c in servterm servterm-agent servterm-desktop-agent servterm-runner-probe servterm-accelerator-probe servterm-resource-guard; do build linux amd64 $c; done
for c in servterm servterm-desktop-agent servterm-accelerator-probe; do build darwin arm64 $c; done
ls -l "$CIP_ARTIFACTS"

mkdir -p .cip/release
for n in servterm-linux-amd64 servterm-agent-linux-amd64 servterm-desktop-agent-linux-amd64 servterm-runner-probe-linux-amd64 servterm-accelerator-probe-linux-amd64 servterm-resource-guard-linux-amd64 servterm-darwin-arm64 servterm-desktop-agent-darwin-arm64 servterm-accelerator-probe-darwin-arm64; do
  v="CIP_PROMOTED_ARTIFACT_$(printf '%s' "$n" | tr 'a-z.-' 'A-Z__')"
  p=$(eval "printf '%s' \"\${$v-}\"")
  [ -n "$p" ] || { echo "no tested build artifact for $n; refusing to rebuild after merge"; exit 1; }
  cp "$p" ".cip/release/$n"
done
ls -l .cip/release
